column3: “My self loathes my life” is rendered “I loathe my own life,” and “let loose on myself” as “give full vent to.” “Being” is rendered “soul.”
NASB supplies “why.”
“Product of your hands” is rendered “labor of Your hands,” and “shone forth on” as “look favorably on.” NASB adds “indeed.”
Close to the Hebrew.

NASB uses an older verb form here. “Iniquity” is rendered “guilt.”
“On your knowledge” is rendered “According to Your knowledge”; NASB supplies “Yet” and renders “deliverer” as “deliverance.”
“Together all around” is rendered “altogether.” “You have swallowed me” is rendered as a question (“wouldst You destroy me”).
NASB uses an older verb form here.

“Loyalty” is rendered “lovingkindness,” and “kept” as “preserved.”

NASB uses an older verb form here.
“See affliction” is rendered “conscious of my misery”; some read “drenched in affliction.”
“So it may rise up” is rendered “should my head be lifted up”; NASB supplies “my head.” NASB uses an older verb form here.
“Changes and an army” is rendered “Hardship after hardship”; the meaning is uncertain.
“I expired” is rendered “Would that I had died.”
NASB supplies “I should have been.”
The written text reads “cease and put”; NASB follows the reading “Would He not let … alone? Withdraw.”
“Deep darkness” is rendered “deep shadow.”
“Not orders” is rendered “without order.”
